questions.stem: According to the passage, in what year did Paradox Museum Miami, the first North American location, open?
questions.evidence: The Miami location, which opened in 2022, was the first in North America.
questions.explanation_ko: 마이애미 지점은 2022년에 문을 열었으며 북미 최초 지점이라고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as an example of Paradox Museum's displays?
questions.evidence: Examples include the mirror maze, the spinning tunnel, and the upside-down room.
questions.explanation_ko: 거울 미로, 회전 터널, 거꾸로 된 방은 언급되지만 살아있는 동물 전시는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the fact that the museum plans to change its exhibits every one to three years?
options: The museum plans to keep its exhibits exactly the same forever.
Regularly changing exhibits is a deliberate strategy meant to bring visitors back again.
The Zero Gravity Room will be permanently removed soon.
Paradox Museum only opens temporary pop-up locations.
questions.evidence: Like any museum, Paradox Museum plans to change its exhibits to keep visitors coming back.
questions.explanation_ko: 전시를 새로 바꾸며 방문객이 다시 찾아오게 한다는 내용에서, 정기적인 전시 교체가 의도된 전략임을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention that Paradox Museum explains the math and science behind each illusion, unlike old carnival funhouses?
options: To highlight what distinguishes the museum from traditional funhouses
To argue that carnival funhouses are outdated and should close
To explain how illusions are dangerous
To criticize visitors who don't understand science
questions.evidence: The difference is that Paradox Museum explains the math and science behind each illusion.
questions.explanation_ko: 이 설명은 전통적인 놀이공원 착시의 집과 이 박물관을 구별 짓는 특징을 강조하기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "immersive" mean, as used in describing a movement toward "immersive art experiences"?
options: art that visitors can only view from far away
art experiences that make visitors feel deeply involved or surrounded
art that is displayed only in traditional frames
art that costs very little money to view
questions.evidence: make the visitors feel like they are taking part in art rather than just looking at it
questions.explanation_ko: immersive는 관람객이 예술 속에 깊이 몰입해 있다고 느끼게 만드는 것을 뜻합니다.

blanks.sentence_ko: 이 전시들이 상상력에 도전한다고 실행 이사인 Samantha Impellizeri는 말한다.
Speigel은 몰입형 체험이 장소 기반 오락의 자연스러운 발전 과정이라고 말했다.
우리는 유아부터 대학생까지 최고의 현장학습 목적지입니다, 라고 Impellizeri는 말했다.
그는 그것이 가족과 함께 재미있는 사진을 찍을 좋은 기회였다고 말했다.

key_points: Paradox Museum Miami, which opened in 2022 as the chain's first North American location, features more than 70 exhibits that challenge visitors' perceptions using math and science.

Unlike old carnival funhouses, Paradox Museum explains the science behind its illusions, such as the mirror maze and upside-down room, and regularly updates exhibits, like a new Zero Gravity Room, to keep visitors returning.
The museum is part of a broader global trend toward 'immersive art experiences' that use technology to make visitors feel like participants rather than just viewers.
An industry expert describes immersive experiences as combining familiar entertainment elements with new technology to create something visitors haven't seen before.
main_idea: Paradox Museum Miami uses science-based optical illusions and regularly updated exhibits to offer visitors an immersive, ever-changing experience, reflecting a broader global trend in entertainment.
restate_sentence: The 1,000-square-meter museum is housed in Miami's Wynwood arts and entertainment area.
